title: Asahina Mafuyu — In A Silent Library〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heeey! MEIKO, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not seeing them anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After Mafuyu went to the trouble of bringing her gifts for them over too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not like we asked them to meet with us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But they should know about our Valentine's Day party. They could hang around nearby for today, at least...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was wondering why you were all shouting. What are you up to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We were looking for you, MEIKO.
Mafuyu has something for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is for you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A handkerchief?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're always watching over us, so I decided to make you a gift for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yours has a butterfly embroidered on it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu did that, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for making this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The rest of us also prepared gifts, so you should come party with us if you're in the mood!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll think about it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, if you're also looking for KAITO, he was just over there a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He was?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, he might also appear if we keep shouting his name! Hey, KAITO! We have yummy chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... They're sweet and delicious...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please come talk to us. Even just for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Doesn't seem like he wants to.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't have to give this to him.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's too soon to give up.
I mean, you made this just for him, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. You should give it to him if you can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, what kind of person doesn't show up after having their name called this much? If he really is just nearby, then there's no way he doesn't know we're here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If he wants to force our hands, we'll just have to give him what he's asking for.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Th-This has gotten intense all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. But I also want you to give this to KAITO personally. I'm very interested in seeing how he reacts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's assuming he's going to accept my gift.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually believe that he won't be able to refuse.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He won't?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, he talks about how important it is to be honest about your feelings on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you tell him you want him to have it, he won't be able to refuse your gift.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I tell him that I want him to have it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This handkerchief will likely just go to waste if I don't give it to him...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I'm not sure that equates to me genuinely wanting him to have it...)
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aha, you finally decided to show yourself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who wouldn't, with you all making such a racket? Anyway, what do you all want?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have something for you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I embroidered handkerchiefs for everyone as gifts for Valentine's Day. I was just handing them out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Embroidered...? You mean this blue flower?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's a bellflower.
I thought it suited you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'll take it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He really took it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See? What did I say?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But that was so anticlimactic.
I wanted to see him smile, but he only gave us his usual, stone-faced expression.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, anything else would've been pretty startling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are we done here?
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, don't go!
We brought chocolates, so you should stay and have some with us!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad you managed to hand out all of your Valentine's Day gifts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too. Oh, actually...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't given Mochizuki her gift yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought about giving it to her at school, but I sort of want to do it at your house, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, let's both give our gifts to her when she visits next. I'm sure she's going to be very happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*
